audit_items.proof_trace: When `self.debt < repay_amount`, the code correctly computes `total_debt = self.debt.ceil()` and adds `coin.value() - total_debt` to `cash_reserve`, then zeros `self.debt`. Since `coin.value()` is an integer and `self.debt < coin.value()` (float), `ceil(self.debt) <= coin.value()` always holds, so no underflow and no excess vanishes. The unit test (reserve.move:L459-466) directly validates this path: repay_extra=2, ceil(debt)=10001, confirms cash_reserve increases by exactly 1.
